title: AI Identifies Three Brain Patterns: Stanford study finds 3 child biotypes; patterns may inform targeted care
summary_full: Stanford Medicine researchers identified three distinct brain patterns in children diagnosed with ADHD and anxiety. Their study suggests differences in brain connectivity can predict the development of these conditions. Researchers analyzed data from children aged 9 to 11 in the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study. The findings may lead to more tailored treatment approaches for those experiencing attention and emotional difficulties.
